key_insight: TreeC learns understandable energy-management strategies with competitive performance against model predictive control and reinforcement learning across diverse problems.
engineering_relevance: Energy-management algorithms can lower costs in electrified Belgian homes, but average savings do not yet outweigh current implementation costs and effort.
method: Compare rule-based, optimization, and machine-learning energy management.
Introduce TreeC to learn understandable control strategies for batteries, heat pumps, and other energy systems.
Evaluate methods in three simulation cases and one real-world experiment.
evidence_signal: Hardware testing exposed performance losses relative to simulation: TreeC faced insufficiently representative training data, while model predictive control faced unreliable real-time inputs.
watch_item: Validate controllers on actual hardware before deployment; simulation performance may not transfer under real-world data limitations.
paper_title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
